answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded pearl. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its horizon from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the echo expensive rather than free. Seal 1jkns.
